set.body:
Governing design: storymodel4s/docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md, sections 3, 6-10. Repository owner: storyatlas4s.

This is a post-M1 sibling under delivery epic bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD, not a new M1 completion condition. Local prerequisite: M1 final acceptance bd-01M34JJ7A88WEAR1MX61B5Q3J9. General chronology and static publication are separate capabilities.

External entry gate: StoryModel temporal-query ticket bd-01M3549Q5W5KQFSY3ZH81FARM0. Remain blocked until its exact reachable producer revision, schema/query versions, generator, fixture digests, expected answers and gate receipts exist. Record the concrete handoff, then open this local issue and run consumer adoption. Foreign IDs are provenance, never local dependency edges; an upstream closed status alone cannot satisfy entry.

Acceptance:
1. Extend the existing M1 loader, semantic selection and saved-investigation contracts in storyatlas4s. Link recall and encoding timelines, mapping heatmap, region-mass/precision time series and an evidence/clock inspector using provider-supplied values. Keep independent axes/horizons, repeated occurrences, disjoint regions and untimed keyboard navigation.
2. Consume the exact checked StoryModel temporal query/projection/view packet. Display measure kind, units, conditioning, allocation policy, candidate coverage and missingness. Distinguish support-only from allocated density and point atoms. No viewer-side inference, normalization, probability reconstruction or implicit trajectory smoothing.
3. Maintain source/external/unallocated/omitted mass and typed failures. Rebinning/cropping use provider queries; zoom and top-k never redistribute removed mass. Preserve selection by artifact-qualified semantic IDs and exact regions rather than pixels or array positions.
4. Cache with mapping/projection/query/axis/policy/bin identities; cancel obsolete work and reject stale responses. Scientific profile changes select a new checked artifact/projection and are distinct from visual zoom, colour and layout settings. No mandatory network service.
5. Save/reopen exact artifact/projection/policy digests, selections and view state. Export the same permitted quantities through an accessible table, figure and receipt. Denied content stays out of query payloads, DOM/accessibility, diagnostics and exports; media bytes do not enter a shareable report by default.
6. Use synthetic precomputed annotation-only and AV profile pairs for engineering acceptance; actual video acquisition, calibration and superiority are separate gates. Include narrow, broad, multimodal, repeated-media, untimed, external and failed cases. Demonstrate conservation, policy switching, disjoint brushing, coarse-to-fine zoom and saved-state replay against independent expected answers.
7. Close with exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, schema/query versions, fixture digests and CLI/independent-reader/viewer agreement on region masses and timing. Run exact-pin compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS plus existing shell smoke and temporal browser courts, named failure injections and separate cold review. Follow browser ownership audits and cleanup. Measure responsiveness on named hardware/fixture; do not report unmeasured latency targets as performance.
set.title: Post-M1: linked temporal mapping and uncertainty inspection
